evidence: The issue defines a default weekly value summary and a public done-when, but no GH703 spec packet, PR, or implementation branch exists.
Search of open pull requests and remote branches found no work item that owns GH703.
The current GH556 contract explicitly keeps weekly scheduling opt-in, so GH703 changes approved product policy and requires a new spec.
Current no-clone payloads omit the health-report scheduler stack, making final installation acceptance dependent on coordination with GH699.
GH703 can be specified independently of GH700 and GH701, while metric taxonomy, consent, privacy, platform, and lifecycle choices remain human product decisions.
